subject.title: fix(agents): dripping proxy SSE bodies cancel via outer abort

question: Should `ProxyStreamOptions` gain a second opt-in total-stream deadline, or should this PR be narrowed to regression coverage for the existing outer-signal lifetime contract?
rationale: The reported cancellation mechanism is already present on current `main`; the branch's unique runtime behavior is a new policy and API surface with no identified production caller.

options.title: Narrow to outer-abort proof
options.body: Remove `streamDeadlineMs` and its timer path while retaining concise native loopback coverage for active-reader cancellation by the existing signal.

options.title: Sponsor the new deadline
options.body: Keep the option only with an identified production caller, documented ownership semantics, and compatibility coverage showing why the outer signal is insufficient.

recommendation.title: Narrow to outer-abort proof
recommendation.body: Remove `streamDeadlineMs` and its timer path while retaining concise native loopback coverage for active-reader cancellation by the existing signal.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the proxy response timeout and lifetime behavior that the proposed option would extend.
